question: What practice should be maintained whenever the yogini assembly takes place?
premises: The practice is to be done always at the proper time.
It occurs when there is a yogini assembly.
inference: One should always drink that substance whenever the yogini assembly takes place.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tat is unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: One should always drink that at the proper time, when there is an assembly of yoginis.
